summary: The generated WI only covers the shearing stage and one generic press block. The trim & piercing (500 T) and restrike stages are missing, and every press setting and tool dimension is missing (shut heights 1285/1420/1400 mm, strokes 350/625/600 mm, pressures, all draw/trim/restrike dimensions), so an operator cannot set up or inspect the part. It also adds assembly-fixture steps and max/min shut-height and liner checks that do not exist in the golden, has wrong document/revision dates and unit, tells the operator to 'rework' an off-thickness sheet instead of replacing it, and is written in English instead of Hindi.
